applied_map.before: Splitting/merging grouped with renaming as only representation changes; Registry dependent exclusively on identity; every document assumed to possess permanent identity.
applied_map.proposal: Distinguish rename/relocation from semantic split/merge, requiring explicit retained/new identities and provenance rather than assume same knowledge. Scope normalized identity away from excluded functional files. Identity is the logical key, while entries/consumers may require edition, location and owner contracts. Preserve IDs across ordinary version/reclassification; no unplanned allocations.
applied_map.closure_criterion: Split/merge does not silently reuse one identity for distinct successors; rename and edition evolution retain valid identity; functional exclusion and key-versus-full-record distinction explicit.

applied_map.before: Registry does not duplicate information and does not represent relationships; Knowledge Graph describes relationships and its introduction completed Discovery; Relationships owner is absent.
applied_map.proposal: Distinguish authoritative typed Relationships records from Registry references/derived indexes and Knowledge Graph projections. Non-redundancy means one semantic authority with traceable edition provenance, not a physical single-copy rule. Preserve historical emergence but do not describe Registry/Graph as all current Discovery capabilities.
applied_map.closure_criterion: Relationship ownership and permitted projections explicit; no exclusive graph or physical no-copy contract; current Discovery overview does not omit other registered responsibilities.
applied_map.after: Relationships owns typed records; Registry and graph project with exact provenance; repeated derived values permitted; current Discovery scope qualified

applied_map.before: Baseline a set of documents; always a validated state; stability enough for creation; graph state preserved without exact-edition selection, approval and pinned context.
applied_map.proposal: Define collective snapshot of explicitly selected immutable document editions plus relevant pinned relationship context/evidence. Distinguish logical identity, Version/Revision, edition Status and Baseline; validate selection and require explicit approval/inclusion per policy. Research phases may be selected only when criteria are satisfied. Preserve old snapshots; do not infer membership from edits, validation or current paths.
applied_map.closure_criterion: Members resolve to exact editions; validation is distinct from approval/selection; changed Draft successors do not alter past membership; no automatic whole-graph or research-phase snapshot assumed.
applied_map.after: Exact immutable edition selection, explicit approval/eligibility/inclusion and scoped pinned context; research phases not automatic Baselines
